_about: What was planted in the synthetic artifacts. Used to grade a reconciliation run; never shown to the model.

pdf_vs_spreadsheet.kind: stale constant in a disguised field
pdf_vs_spreadsheet.detail: White-text margin field recomputes the likelihood subtotal with weight 1 for 'Prior hostile contact'; the total reads it. Spreadsheet uses 10.
Hazardous materials warns from 'Possible' up; spreadsheet warns only at the highest answer of a Critical factor.
PDF multiplies the three uncertainty subtotals (with its own thresholds); spreadsheet sums the rows.
PDF mitigation subtotal can be 0; spreadsheet applies MAX(1, ...). Never changes a visible result.

guide_claims.claim: Prior hostile contact is weighted Critical (10).
Warning if the highest answer is selected for any Critical factor.
Any indication of hazardous materials (Possible or higher) displays the warning.
Approval required if the warning is displayed or overall risk is High or Extreme.
Overall risk is calculated from the three sections; mitigation lowers it.
guide_claims.kind: underspecified: no formula, no thresholds, silent on the minimum subtotal (P4)

guide_claims.claim: Uncertainty level reflects unconfirmed information; Confirmed least, Possible most.
guide_claims.kind: partly testable: option ordering checks out, but no formula or thresholds, so it cannot settle P3
